desc:
The evil Wizard caught the fairies to drain ALL their magic... but they ESCAPED!

Now he hunts them down and traps them in magic spheres. Will you hide, or will you hunt?

✨ PLAY AS A FAIRY
• Shrink down and fly around fun, colorful maps
• Find the sneakiest hiding spots
• Free your trapped friends from the spheres!
• Survive until the timer runs out!

🧙 PLAY AS THE WIZARD
• Hunt the tiny fairies before time is up
• Catch them and trap them in magic spheres
• Catch them all to win!

⭐ COLLECT STARS
• Earn stars every round
• Fly through the lobby obby to grab bonus stars

🛍️ SHOP
• Wings 🪽
• Hammers 🔨
• Morph Potions 🧪
• Star packs ⭐

🗳️ Vote for the next map
🎁 Daily rewards. Come back every day!

👍 Like the game and ⭐ Favorite to get updates!
